title: CYBRIK model-class health signal v1
description: Provider-neutral health/readiness signal for a policy-selectable model class. Consumed fail-closed: a caller MUST treat an absent, stale (observed_at older than the freshness window), or unrecognized signal as 'unavailable' and route elsewhere or deny. Carries NO vendor/endpoint detail — only the abstract class and its readiness. Status: ACCEPTED FOR IMPLEMENTATION (v0.1.0; not stable v1/GA).

observed_at.description: When this health was observed. A signal older than the caller's freshness window MUST be treated as 'unavailable'.

reason.description: Required when state != 'ready'. Vendor-neutral, secret-free explanation (e.g. 'capacity_saturated', 'weights_loading'). No runtime-native diagnostics or endpoints.

capacity.description: Optional coarse capacity signal for routing. No hostnames or replica identities.
